Name: Launch motors
Note: Twin 3-phase outrunners direct-drive the launch wheels; high torque and speed.

Name: Speed controllers
Note: 18 A continuous brushless ESCs; powered from ATX 12 V high-current rail.

Name: Launch wheels
Note: 40A middle-soft shore durometer elastomer tire grips the 40 mm ball.

Name: Wheel mounts
Specification: BaneBots 1/2" hex hub with 4 mm bore
Note: Couples the DT750 4 mm motor shaft to the BaneBots 1/2" hex wheel bore.

Name: Launch barrel & mounts
Specification: 3D-printed barrel and motor tabs (canon v54, motor_mount_tab_ext v58)
Note: Autodesk Fusion 360 assembly ASM v145; holds twin motors with wheel cutouts.

Name: Hopper container
Note: Bulk ball container mounted above the rotary agitation and feed throat.

Name: Feeder agitator servo
Note: Rotates the bottom agitator disk (pusher_with_servo v12) to prevent bridging.

Name: Feeder gate servo
Note: Actuates the escapement gate (feed_base_with_servo v52) to meter balls.

Name: Feed throat
Note: Curves balls down by gravity from the hopper bottom into the launch barrel.

Name: Turntable bearing
Specification: 120 mm Aluminum Lazy Susan rotating plate (Amazon B07F3VHGKX)
Note: Circular ball-bearing ring supports robot weight and enables 360° pan rotation.

Name: Pan / yaw servo
Note: Mounted to vertical base bracket (base_leg v15); sweeps launcher horizontally.

Name: Tilt / elevation servo
Note: Acts on circular quadrant horn (hand_servo v64) to control pitch angle.

Name: Controller
Note: Generates 6 independent servo/ESC PWM signals and handles BLE hardware serial.

Name: Bluetooth module
Note: Enables wireless command link from custom iOS iPhone app (Ping Robot).

Name: Power supply
Note: Provides heavy 12 V rail for brushless ESCs and 5 V rail for the 4 servos.

Name: Base enclosure
Note: Houses ATX PSU, Arduino Mega, ESCs, wiring harness, and turntable mount.

Name: Power switch
Note: Top deck switch pulls ATX PS_ON green wire to ground to turn on DC rails.

Name: Power & servo breakout
Note: J1–J9, ATX Molex input, C1 1000 µF, C2 470 µF, C3 100 nF; unrouted draft.

Name: BLE level divider
Specification: 1 kΩ and 2 kΩ 1/4W metal film resistors
Note: Protects HM-10 3.3 V RX input from Arduino Mega 5 V TX1 output signal.

Name: Rail filter capacitors
Note: Smooths 12 V brushless ESC switching noise and 5 V servo stall surges.

Name: Wiring harness & terminals
Specification: 10-pin Mega harness, Molex connector, 3-pin headers, 3.5 mm bullets
Note: Organized clean wiring between wooden base electronics and moving gimbal.
